get.description: Returns projects in the current workspace with latest production deployment summary.

post.description: Creates a project in the current workspace.

get.description: Returns project details, recent deployments, and environment variable summaries.

patch.description: Updates project build, git, deployment, and integration settings.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a project and invalidates its domains and deployment aliases.

post.description: Stores framework and compute detection metadata reported by the CLI.

get.description: Returns custom-domain bindings projected onto one project.

get.summary: Read desired and observed environment serving state

get.description: Returns deployment details, its observed serving address when active, and project build settings.
Returns deployments for a project with pagination metadata.
Returns whether local CLI build-log upload is enabled for deployment producers.

post.description: Creates the single build-log session row for a build or deployment attempt.
Appends one contiguous, idempotent event batch to Sibyl.
Idempotently records the terminal build-log state and bounded summary.

post.summary: Attach hostname under workspace DNS zone

delete.summary: Detach hostname from workspace DNS zone

post.description: Creates a temporary preview-protection bypass secret and returns header/query credentials.

delete.description: Deletes a temporary preview-protection bypass secret.

put.description: Creates or updates ONREZA Compute settings. The health check path is captured by the next deployment that becomes LIVE.

get.description: Returns managed PostgreSQL databases for the workspace with plan and runtime status metadata.

post.description: Creates a managed PostgreSQL database and returns the local database row plus the generated password.

get.description: Returns one managed PostgreSQL database with project attachments and plan metadata.

patch.description: Updates mutable database settings such as CU size, password, or suspend timeout.

delete.description: Deletes a managed PostgreSQL database and waits for the provider terminal result.

post.description: Starts or resumes compute for a managed PostgreSQL database.
Stops compute for a managed PostgreSQL database.

get.description: Returns connection strings for the main database branch and includes the decrypted password when available.
Returns managed PostgreSQL branches enriched with local branch metadata.

post.description: Creates a managed PostgreSQL branch and persists local branch metadata.

get.description: Returns one managed PostgreSQL database branch.

delete.description: Deletes a managed PostgreSQL branch and marks local metadata as deleted.

get.description: Returns connection strings for a managed PostgreSQL branch.

patch.description: Creates or updates a project attachment for a managed PostgreSQL database.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user identity used by CLI clients.
Returns the current workspace identity and billing plan summary for CLI clients.
Returns lightweight deployment status for CLI polling.

post.description: Creates a SOURCE_BUNDLE_V1 upload plan for a deployment.
Returns immutable upload plans for missing dependency materializations.
Persists the exact verified runtime graph after immutable blob readback.
Records a terminal client-side SOURCE_BUNDLE_V1 upload failure.
Confirms SOURCE_BUNDLE_V1 upload completion and starts artifact ingest.

post.summary: Finish a deployment that failed before source upload

anyOf.description: DNS records that block an ONREZA-managed hostname route.
External Git provider credential recovery details.

details.description: Structured error details. Shape depends on the error code.

post.summary: Finish a deployment skipped before source upload

get.description: Returns access/runtime logs for a project.
Returns project environment variables with secret values redacted.

post.description: Creates or updates one project environment variable and returns write-only secret metadata.
